holes.name: Smal öppning

holes.notes: Straight ENE hole, heavily drought-browned fairway between a gravel road/treeline (N) and tree-dotted rough (S); corridor sits ~10 m north of the straight tee-green line mid-hole. Fairway starts ~35 m ahead of the tee at a greener irrigated patch (-282..-262). Green traced 342 m2; all GPS g-markers inside. The pale smooth patch hugging the green's SW edge (RGB ~164/147/127, no crisp edge) is worn bare apron, not a bunker. No water. Single mown tee pad (vivid core 14x4 m, mown pad ~15x6 m) containing the GPS tee marker.

holes.note: Utmanande korthål upp för backen mot ett litet greenområde – de sista hundra metrarna stiger fem meter, så ta klubba nog. Fem hole-in-one är gjorda här sedan 2007.
holes.notes: Par 3 (GPS tee==target) playing SSW over mottled tussocky heath with scattered pines; no mown fairway, only a pale walk-up apron in the last ~25 m. Green 320 m2, clear disc with a tree shadow on its SE edge. GPS green markers sit ~4 m NE of the visible disc: gf falls ~2-3 m OUTSIDE the traced putting surface (imagery is orthorectified, so this is GPS offset, not registration). Tee complex is one large mown pad plus a small forward pad 13 m SW along the play line. A near-black peaty pond at approx (16..39, 259..291) lies ~120 m E of this green in the waste toward holes 4/8 - not counted to this hole.

holes.name: Kort dogleg höger
holes.note: Kort par 4 med dogleg höger, svagt nedför, till en lutande green. Banans index 18 – ett hål att ta vara på.
holes.notes: Long SSE hole (bearing ~154). Fairway is in two parts separated by a heather/scrub belt that fully crosses the corridor at z~450-500: ring 1 is the broad drought-pale landing corridor NE/right of the straight line (between heath and the tarn chain), ring 2 is the mown band on the direct line - a green lobe at (-65..-43, 458..497) merging into a ~15-18 m wide neck down to the green apron; verified mown by texture+colour sampling (edges fuzzy in drought colours, hence medium). Played line per GPS target and the club routing runs straight, carrying ~80-120 m of heath before ring 2. The two peaty tarns (one marsh system, split by a vegetated neck at z~458) flank the corridor's east edge: the upper tarn is ~10-15 m off ring 1's edge; the lower pool is nearer hole 8's line (~18 m) and its dark tail actually continues to z~519 - expect hole 8's tracer to report it too (dedupe). Single long tee pad 22x6.5 m (possibly two pads in line) exactly at the GPS tee. Long single mown tee pad axis 159 vs play line 154.

holes.name: Dubbelgreenen
holes.note: Par 5 som svänger dogleg höger efter drygt 200 meter – smalt, med vatten längs högersidan, och med möjlighet att chansa eller spela säkert. Stor dubbelgreen delad med åttan: var aktsam vid inspelet, spelare från hål 8 kan stå på green.
holes.notes: WEST corridor of the twin 4/8 complex; routing reference (disc 8 on the west line, west flag) confirms. Green = the GPS-marked green at (51,167.5) - both GPS 4 and 8 records point here; ring (344 m2) is anchored on the GPS gf/gb axis because the irrigated collar merges seamlessly into approach turf (no resolvable mow line; south edge verified by transect at z~181). Corridor length tee->green along centerline 459 m (straight 431 m) - the LONGER of the pair, takes the card par-5 440 m. Fairway is coherent mown turf only in the north (z 183-260 plus a narrow tongue along the west treeline to z~333); z 340-490 is drought-degraded sandy waste with two mown remnants (rings 2-3); the last ~110 m before the tee is heath/scrub and tracks - no ring. Second tee entry (61,573) is a bright 14x11 m oval 30 m NW of the GPS tee: likely a forward tee, but could be a practice/short-course feature - the routing line's south end maps nearer to it than to the GPS T. GPS target for 8 (107.8,380) sits in the EAST corridor's landing pod, 35+ m off this corridor - consistent with the corrupt 4/8 records. The tee tarn at (89-142,547-605) (traced under hole 4) also lies immediately E of this tee.

holes.name: Tre platåer
holes.note: Medellångt par 4 som svänger kraftigt vänster. Efter kröken faller marken tolv meter, så inspelet är ofta dolt – mot en stor green i tre platåer som lutar ifrån dig.
holes.notes: Plays ESE from immediately beside hole 4's green (back tee pad abuts that green's north-east edge with ~1 m gap; GPS T sits on the second, drought-worn pad), matching the routing reference where 5's tee stands at 4's flag. Drops across unmown sandy heath for the first ~120 m (no fairway - real carry), then the corridor swings right, south of a prominent dead/brown tree clump at (210-245,160-190), runs along a green swale and climbs NE to the green. Green is a bright uniform kidney, 555 m2, all three GPS markers inside with 3-6 m spare - the crispest green of my three (high confidence for the green itself; corridor edges are drought-mottled, hence medium overall). Upper-terrace mown remnant at (190-207,171-205) traced as a separate ring; the band x 240-260 is bridged across scattered pines. No water beside the corridor (dark patches at (280-330,230-275) checked at 4x: pines and shadows only). Centerline 321 m vs straight 288 m - gentle S-curve per the routing reference.

Fairway is a drought-pale mown band ~40 m wide; the first ~90 m from the tee is trampled sandy waste/paths, so the ring starts ~z=330. Gentle S-curve followed by the centerline (+1.5% vs straight). No bunkers, no water.

holes.name: John Bauer-hålet
holes.note: Banans kortaste hål och dess John Bauer-hål: över vatten mot en stor, bred green med storskogen tätt inpå – akta out of bounds till vänster. Teen är ombyggd och höjd så att green syns, och här är banans flesta hole-in-one gjorda.
holes.notes: 131 m par 3 playing WSW (GPS tee==target). Large green (618 m2); its S edge lies partly under tree shadow so that edge is +-3 m. One long tee pad (~33 m, multiple markers on one strip; W third slightly duller). Only fairway is the short mown strip in front of the tee; the rest of the corridor is mown heath with scattered pines and bare trampled patches. Centerline bows N around mid-corridor tree clumps. No bunkers, no sand.

Green is the second (NE) green lobe: an E-W kidney at x 70-93, z 141-153, 224 m2 traced - a pine on its west edge shadows that margin so the true surface may extend 1-2 m further west. GPS gc/gf/gb for hole 4 are a duplicate of hole 8's west-green record and sit ~30 m SW of this green; gc is deliberately NOT inside this ring. Corridor length tee->green along centerline 398 m (straight 396 m) - the SHORTER of the pair, takes the card par-4 366 m (8% over straight-line; flagged). Fairway is one continuous corridor z 177-431 drifting east into a bright landing pod (x 92-131, z 370-425); from z 431 back to the tee is bare sandy waste (gx~0, excluded) with one small mown island (second ring). Tees are small worn pads on the north rim of the near-black tee tarn, 2-5 m from its edge; GPS T sits on a dull strip between them. The two marsh pools lie in the wooded belt 15-25 m west of the played line.

holes.notes: Dogleg left (~46 deg at the GPS target) running W then SW up to the green on the clubhouse knoll (670 m2, immediately E of the red-roofed clubhouse). FLAG: the GPS back-tee point sits on bare sandy heath ~18 m E (behind) of the only visible mown tee pad centred (-52,20). Fairway is a drought-browned pale/green mown band 25-45 m wide that only begins ~140 m from the tee (x~-190); the tee shot carries open sandy heath/waste, and forest lines the inside (S) of the dogleg. Mown-vs-heath boundary is fuzzy in the drought colouring, hence medium confidence on fairway edges. Hole 18's green is a separate disc just 35 m N of this green (both by the clubhouse) - do not confuse them. Centerline +10% vs straight reflects the genuine dogleg. No bunkers, no water in play.

Green traced by radial transects, 442 m2, gc/gf/gb all inside; SW apron tongue and N fringe trimmed by hand where drought-green apron matched the surface. Fairway edges are fuzzy drought-browned heath transitions traced by eye at 2x - width good to ~5-8 m. No bunkers, no water. Bottom-right green blob near the tee crop is hole 18's green, not part of this hole.

holes.name: Signaturhålet
holes.note: Banans signaturhål, nedför från tee och med vattnet i spel både på utslaget och vid inspelet. Svensk Golf kallar häftiga tolvan ett av banans svåraste hål – men också dess största stund: här är det vattnet, inte tallskogen, som ställer kraven.
holes.notes: Dogleg right at the surveyed target: corridor runs NNE west of the big peaty tarn, then the approach crosses a ~20 m neck between the north path and the tarn's west arm; the played line skirts the pond's NW shore by ~6 m at the tightest, matching the routing map. GREEN IS OVERSIZED: brightness/greenness transects and a 2-D classification mask show one continuous dark-green surface bounded by pale apron - ~860 m2 even after trimming the lusher N collar band; putting surface and collar are indistinguishable in drought, so the ring likely includes collar. gc sits ~5 m SSE of the surface's true centroid; gf sits in a distinct front (SW) lobe; green edge is only ~5 m from the water bank on the E/SE. Tarn (near-black peat water, ~10,700 m2) traced from a darkness+texture mask, largest connected component, DP-simplified and hand-cleaned: N/E shores reliable; SE margin approximate where water grades into wet scrub; NE corner clipped at the crop edge (z=-620) beside a small jetty on the N shore, so it may extend a few m further north. 17 shoreline points used (above the 6-12 guideline) because the tarn has two lobes joined by a narrow middle. Single round tee pad, GPS T on it. No bunkers.

holes.note: Banans index 1. Smal fairway på utslaget, med sjön till höger vid tee; når du inte ända fram till kurvan är det lätt hänt att hamna mask bakom tallarna till vänster om fairway.
holes.notes: Dogleg-left hole running south from a tee (red T) at the NE tip of the big NW lake down to a green at the south end. Play bearing off the tee ~208 deg (SSW) to a surveyed landing/pivot at ~(-107,-403), then the approach bends left to ~168 deg into the green. Putting surface ~517 m2, gc inside ring. Water = the big NW lake (~10,500 m2, silt-margined) which the early corridor runs along on its east/south shore; only that shore need be covered per brief. The dark tarn east of the mid corridor is hole 14's water (shared centroid ~11.5,-410.5), so it is excluded here. Heavily wooded hole; fairway width/shape is interpretive (patchy mown turf), hence medium confidence. No sand bunkers visible.

holes.name: Över vattnet
holes.note: Korthål över vatten mot en stor, härlig green. Elva hole-in-one har gjorts här sedan 2001.
holes.notes: Par 3, ~148 m forced carry playing due north (bearing ~14 deg) from a mown tee pad (red T at south) over a dark forest tarn (~5,700 m2) to a large green (~698 m2, gc inside ring) on the north shore. The tarn sits directly between tee and green on the line of play. Fairway ring given is the mown green-surround/apron just north of the water (does not overlie the tarn). No sand bunkers visible.

holes.name: Långsmal green
holes.note: Smal fairway och dogleg höger, med out of bounds mycket nära fairways vänstra kant. Inspelet går mot en långsmal, liten green – akta vänstersidan särskilt noga.
holes.notes: Runs almost due south (~309 m) down a dry, tawny fairway strip pinched between the west moor/bog and the tree-and-house line to the east. Putting surface is a compact bright disc (251 m2, near the small end); gc marker sits inside. Fairway is a drought-tan corridor, not bright green, so it was traced as the smooth open band rather than by turf colour. Mild left kink at the aim point (target 320.8,8.7) before the green sets ~20 m west. Visible mown tee pads form a N-S bench ~26-49 m south (forward) of the surveyed championship back tee at (319.4,-220.2); no pad is clearly mown at the GPS back-tee pixel itself. No open water or sand bunkers beside the hole (the bright bare patches nearby are heath/hardpan, not traps).

holes.name: Nästan en par 4
holes.note: Utslag över vatten, sedan dogleg först höger och sedan vänster. Den med längd och mod kan nästan spela det som en par 4 – trots myren längs hela högersidan. Inspel mot en bred men grund green: slå inte för långt.
holes.notes: Par 5 playing NW (bearing ~318). A dark tarn (~2300 m2, traced from an isolated crop) sits directly on the line just NW of the tee, so the drive is a forced carry over its corner; the fairway lands and runs NW up the LEFT/west side of the straight tee-green line. Green (478 m2) is a clean rounded surface at the top-left in a tree-ringed clearing; gc inside. Centerline follows tee -> carry over tarn -> fairway landing (~112,0) -> corridor spine -> green; measured length 366 m vs 352 straight, consistent with the card's 381 after the usual back-tee slide. Tee is a mown cluster right at the surveyed back tee (241,116) with a smaller pad to its NW. No sand bunkers.

holes.name: Uppför hem
holes.note: Uppför, sexton meter, i en dogleg vänster mot en dold green vid klubbhuset. Ett långt utslag ger bra möjligheter inför andraslaget, men det är smalt de sista 100–150 metrarna.
holes.notes: Par 5, a big sweeping left dogleg. From the tee (top-right) the open corridor bulges NORTH of the straight line, running west along the higher ground, then curves SW and down to the green on the clubhouse knoll (bottom-left, clubhouse with pool just SW of the green). Heavily forested between corridor arms, so the fairway was traced as the swept open band; medial centerline length 397 m vs 366 straight, matching the card's 405. Green (477 m2) is a rounded surface; gc inside, front (NE) apron trimmed off. Tee is a mown pad at (-56.6,-132.1) just E/back of the surveyed back tee (-66.3,-124.9). No water or sand bunkers on the hole (bright ground near the clubhouse is path/bare heath).
